sql: SELECT CAST((SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NOT NULL, 1, 0)) - SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NULL, 1, 0))) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.name), IIF(SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NOT NULL, 1, 0)) - SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NULL, 1, 0)) > 0, 'NO', 'YES') FROM longest_absense_from_school AS T1 LEFT JOIN disabled AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name
SELECT AVG(T1.month) FROM longest_absense_from_school AS T1 INNER JOIN disabled AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name INNER JOIN male AS T3 ON T1.name = T3.name
